paths.name: plain
paths.notes: guard lifts and folds in as the blade rolls onto its top, then drops into the wide left windup (arm B's straight blend overreaches 0.32 m)

paths.name: over_the_top
paths.notes: blade lifts and rolls onto the top level, then drops left and cocks sideways

paths.name: hub_drop
paths.notes: lifts to the hub, then drops left into the sideways windup
